body:
Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer directed. This is the deferred remainder of #24802, whose body quotes the maintainer verbatim (「同意建议的改进」).
Reader: the `checklist-author` os-dev session that built #24802 / PR #24811. One small ledger PR on `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`.
Dedupe (open AND closed), objectstack: "checklist clause record-discussion-mentions mention notification recipients read access" → 3 hits, none on this. They are #24785 (the defect, now fixed), #22026 (mark-read receipt organization, a different defect) and #6927 (a client README parameter).

## What

#24802's Scope item 1, fourth bullet, asked for a clause on `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` for #24785's fix. Under RUNNER rule 2 that clause had to wait until the fix PR merged, so PR #24811 shipped without it and said so. The fix, PR #24794, merged on 2026-10-20 as `e5b3de06a6`.

Add the clause:

- An @mention notification reaches a mentioned user only when that user can read the comment's record. A mentioned user who cannot read it gets no notification, whether the mention names them by user id or by email. The author is never notified.
- The oracle sits at the level PR #24794's own Summary states it. Its pin is `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`. Name the layer that pin drives, per RUNNER rule 6: a real kernel and engine, with plugin-security's read layer played by a middleware.
- The live leg runs on a walled boot, per RUNNER's walled entry, for the cross-organization case. A stock `single` boot covers the same-organization reader excluded by the record's own sharing.
- Carry `QA-source: #24783 · records-forms.record-discussion-mentions · acceptance[4]`, a `revision` bump and a `history` row naming #24785 and #24794.

Gates: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`, plus what `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives.
